thread:
maria: Quick sync — staging rollout for optimize-toolkit v0.9 scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need clear owners for: quant recommendations, batching/cache defaults, and regression guards. Who can own which piece? cc @kevin @asha
kevin: I can own batching defaults + rollout gating. Will open a PR with config + canary policy today (aiming EOD).
asha: I’ll take quant recommendations. Finalizing quant profiles for the Q4 models, but I need QA input on acceptable accuracy/latency tradeoffs.
sam: QA already flagged a regression with the int8 profile on long-context inputs — saw truncation at ~1024 tokens for some prompts. I put a short summary in #incidents. Assigning to @lee to triage.
lee: On it. Reproducing locally now. QA gave repro steps but could use the minimal failing prompt. If anyone has it, drop it here.
sam: Repro command we used: ```python reproduce.py --model redwood-llama-q8 --input tests/long_prompt.txt``` — full logs attached in the incident thread.
asha: That looks like a KV-cache boundary issue when folding attention after quant ops. If confirmed, I can revert the specific quant op change in the model variant and add a regression eval to catch this.
maria: Ownership summary for the release: batching = kevin, quant = asha, triage = lee. Action items: kevin PR by EOD with canary policy, asha adds regression eval + uploads quant profile by EOD, lee to either fix or confirm root cause tomorrow morning. Also need reviewers: kevin -> @maria for perf and @sam for QA.
kevin: Assigning reviewers now. Also planning default batching config: will set `max_batch_size` and latency SLO — will include in PR.
ci-bot: Build #2147 started for kevin/optkit-batching-config — running unit + integration tests.
sam: I’ll run the regression harness against the canary once CI is green. Ping me after.
lee: If I can’t reproduce locally I’ll request the minimal input from QA. @asha can you post the failing prompt or a shortened snippet?
asha: Shortened snippet (sanitized): "<PROMPT_SNIPPET_TRUNCATED>" — DMing full test case & dataset to @lee. Also created `evals/kv-cache-longcontext.yaml` and will push it to the evals repo.
maria: :thumbsup: Thanks. One more ask — @kevin, set batching defaults to `max_batch_size: 8` and `latency_slo_ms: 120` in the PR to align with Dedicated defaults. Also add a feature flag `enable_prefix_cache: true` (default on for Dedicated).
kevin: Will add those. Docs PR for the new flags coming after config PR.
sam: I’ll add a regression alert in the console (webhook + slack) so we get notified if this reappears in prod.
maria: Great. I’ll recap this in tomorrow’s shiproom. If anyone hits blockers tonight, post here. Thanks team :raised_hands:
